bundle.entry: export { SchemeTonalSpot, SchemeVibrant, Hct, argbFromHex, hexFromArgb } from '@material/material-color-utilities';

reason: CI installs with bun --frozen-lockfile, so a new npm dependency cannot land without a bun-regenerated lockfile. The published package also ships extensionless relative imports that break unbundled ESM resolution. This single-file bundle (color-scheme subset only; quantize/score/image modules tree-shaken away) keeps MD3 scheme generation dependency-free and reproducible.
